title: Billing and Coding: Genetic Testing for Lynch Syndrome

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book. The following CPT/HCPCS codes associated with the services outlined in this Billing and Coding Article will not have diagnosis code limitations applied at this time: 0130U, 81210, 81301, 81403, 81435, 81479, 88341, 88342 and 88344.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT/HCPCS codes: 81288, 81292, 81293, 81294, 81295, 81296, 81297, 81298, 81299, 81300, 81317, 81318, 81319, and 0238U.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
